name: check_availability
description: Look up the available times for a date. Returns up to 3 options already phrased to be read out loud. Always use it before proposing a time: never invent availability. If the requested day is full, the tool searches the following days on its own and says so in spokenSummary.

request_body_schema.description: The date and part of day the person asked for.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-09-08. Work it out from {{current_datetime}}. If the person said «mañana» or «el martes», convert it to that exact date.

partOfDay.description: The part of day the person asked for: 'morning' if they said «en la mañana», 'afternoon' if they said «en la tarde», 'any' if they did not specify.
